reason: The empty-list shortcut suppresses the warning, but calling len on a scalar raises TypeError, as confirmed by the failing single-number conversion test.
Report-time evaluation catches the new marker, but it also re-evaluates existing conditions after the test can change their inputs, and two added test cases would themselves report failures.
The reported decimal fits, but the formatter expands 1E-05 to 1.0E-05, which can truncate a previously fitting comment, and the five recorded tests do not cover that case.

Lazy validation fixes get_feature_names, but the shared vocabulary check now succeeds whenever a constructor vocabulary exists, leaving callers that rely on the check exposed to a missing vocabulary_ attribute.
